why: Baseline for verifyReachability.cjs rule 3. Each entry is a preload member with no renderer caller on the day the suite was written (spec Section 143). THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK: the suite fails if a member not named here becomes unreachable, and fails if a member named here becomes reachable without being removed. REGENERATED in Section 145: the first seed was written by a parser that read COMMENTS as object keys, so it contained phantom members (a comment with the words 'member:' produced a bridge member called 'member'). The parser now strips comments before the brace walk, which is why this list is 301 rather than the 315 first recorded - the difference is phantoms removed plus store.get/push/remove and the roles/brokers members genuinely closed.
